name: 约翰内斯·维米尔

points.title: 艺术启蒙期
points.description: 1632年，约翰内斯·维米尔出生于荷兰代尔夫特的一个中产阶级家庭。他的父亲雷尼尔·维米尔是一位织造品商人兼艺术旅店老板，这使维米尔从小接触艺术环境。约1649年，维米尔开始师当地画家康内利斯·德·曼学习绘画技巧。这一时期，维米尔主要创作历史题材作品，受到卡拉瓦乔风格的影响，学习明暗对比技法。1653年，维米尔正式加入圣路加公会，成为独立画家，标志着他艺术生涯的正式开始。
points.descriptionEn: Born in 1632 in Delft, Netherlands, Johannes Vermeer came from a middle-class family. His father, Reynier Vermeer, was a silk weaver and art innkeeper, exposing Vermeer to artistic environments from a young age. Around 1649, Vermeer began studying painting techniques under local artist Cornelis de Man. During this period, Vermeer primarily created historical paintings influenced by Caravaggio's style, learning chiaroscuro techniques. In 1653, Vermeer officially joined the Saint Luke's Guild as an independent painter, marking the formal beginning of his artistic career.

points.title: 风格形成期
points.description: 1653年后，维米尔逐渐形成了自己独特的艺术风格。他开始专注于描绘中产阶级家庭生活的场景，尤其是女性在室内从事日常活动的画面。这一时期的重要作品包括《音乐课》(约1658-1660)和《写信的女人与女仆》(约1660)。维米尔发展出了精湛的光影处理技巧，被称为'代尔夫特大师'。1657年，维米尔接替父亲成为家族旅店的经营者，同时继续绘画创作。1658年，他与卡塔里娜·博尔尼斯结婚，婚后育有15个孩子，其中11个活到成年。
points.descriptionEn: After 1653, Ver gradually developed his unique artistic style. He began focusing on depicting scenes of middle-class domestic life, particularly women engaged in daily activities indoors. Important works from this period include 'The Music Lesson' (c. 1658-1660) and 'A Lady Writing a Letter with Her Maid' (c. 1660). Vermeer developed exceptional techniques for handling light and shadow, earning him the title 'Master of Delft.' In 1657, Vermeer took over his father's inn business while continuing his painting. In 1658, he married Catharina Bolnes, with whom he had 15 children, 11 of whom survived to adulthood.

points.title: 创作巅峰期
points.description: 1660年至1670年是维米尔艺术创作的巅峰时期。这一时期他创作了最著名的作品，包括《戴珍珠耳环的少女》(约1665)、《倒牛奶的女仆》(约1658-1660)、《绘画艺术》(约1666-1668)和《织花边的女子》(约1669-1670)。维米尔的作品以其精湛的光影处理、和谐的色彩搭配和精确的透视法著称。他特别擅长捕捉光线在物体表面的微妙变化，创造出宁静而神秘的氛围。1662年至1663年，维米尔曾担任圣路加公会的会长，表明他在当地艺术界的地位和影响力。
points.descriptionEn: The period from 1660 to 1670 marked the peak of Vermeer's artistic career. During this time, he created his most famous works, including 'Girl with a Pearl Earring' (c. 1665), 'The Milkmaid' (c. 1658-1660), 'The Art of Painting' (c. 1666-1668), and 'The Lacemaker' (c. 1669-1670). Vermeer's works are renowned for their masterful handling of light and shadow, harmonious color combinations, and precise perspective techniques. He excelled at capturing subtle changes in light on surfaces, creating serene and mysterious atmospheres. From 1662 to 1663, Vermeer served as the dean of the Saint Luke's Guild, indicating his prominent position and influence in the local art community.

points.title: 晚年与影响
points.description: 1670年代，维米尔的艺术生涯因法国入侵荷兰而受到严重影响。1672年，法国军队占领了荷兰大部分地区，导致艺术市场崩溃，维米尔的画作销售困难。1675年，维米尔在年仅43岁时去世，留下妻子和11个子女。他的去世被归因于精神崩溃和财务压力。维米尔去世后，他的作品逐渐被遗忘，直到19世纪中期才被重新发现。如今，维米尔被视为荷兰黄金时代最伟大的画家之一，他的作品以其对光线和色彩的精湛处理而闻名于世，对后世艺术产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In the 1670s, Vermeer's artistic career was severely affected by the French invasion of the Netherlands. In 1672, French troops occupied most of the Netherlands, causing the art market to collapse and making it difficult for Vermeer to sell his paintings. In 1675, Vermeer died at the young age of 43, leaving his wife and 11 children. His death was attributed to mental collapse and financial stress. After his death, Vermeer's works gradually fell into obscurity until they were rediscovered in the mid-19th century. Today, Vermeer is regarded as one of the greatest painters of the Dutch Golden Age, famous for his masterful handling of light and color, and his work has had a profound influence on later art.

supporter.zh: 维米尔被誉为光影大师，他的作品完美捕捉了17世纪荷兰中产阶级生活的宁静与优雅。他独特的点彩技法和精湛的光影处理，创造了超越时代的视觉体验。维米尔对女性形象的细腻描绘和对日常场景的诗意升华，展现了他对生活本质的深刻理解。作为荷兰黄金时代的代表画家之一，维米尔的作品以其永恒的美学价值和人文关怀，至今仍能触动观者的心灵。
supporter.en: Vermeer is hailed as a master of light and shadow, whose works perfectly capture the tranquility and elegance of 17th-century Dutch middle-class life. His unique pointillism techniques and masterful handling of light created visual experiences that transcended his time. Vermeer's delicate depictions of female figures and poetic elevation of everyday scenes demonstrate his profound understanding of life's essence. As one of the representative painters of the Dutch Golden Age, Vermeer's works continue to touch viewers' hearts with their eternal aesthetic value and humanistic关怀.

critic.zh: 批评者指出维米尔的作品题材过于狭窄，主要局限于中产阶级家庭场景，缺乏社会批判性和历史深度。他的画作被认为过于理想化，回避了当时荷兰社会的现实问题。此外，维米尔的作品数量稀少（现存仅约34幅），且题材重复，这被一些艺术史学家视为创造力有限的证据。还有人质疑他的技术革新性，认为他的成就更多在于对已有技法的完美运用而非创新。
critic.en: Critics point out that Vermeer's subject matter was overly narrow, primarily limited to middle-class domestic scenes, lacking social critique and historical depth. His paintings are considered overly idealized, avoiding the real issues of contemporary Dutch society. Additionally, Vermeer's small surviving oeuvre (only about 34 works) and repetitive themes have led some art historians to question the breadth of his creativity. Others challenge the innovative nature of his techniques, suggesting his achievements lay more in perfecting existing methods rather than innovation.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，维米尔被定义为荷兰黄金时代的标志性人物，其作品代表了巴洛克艺术的巅峰成就。他的画作因其精湛的光影处理和对日常生活的诗意描绘而备受推崇。维米尔的作品在19世纪被重新发现后，对印象派等后世艺术流派产生了深远影响。在流行文化中，维米尔的作品，尤其是《戴珍珠耳环的少女》，已成为艺术史上的标志性图像，频繁出现在文学、电影和时尚领域，成为永恒美学的象征。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Vermeer is defined as a iconic figure of the Dutch Golden Age, whose works represent the pinnacle of Baroque art. His paintings are highly regarded for their masterful handling of light and shadow and poetic depictions of everyday life. After his rediscovery in the 19th century, Vermeer's works had a profound influence on later art movements, including Impressionism. In popular culture, Vermeer's works, particularly 'Girl with a Pearl Earring', have become iconic images in art history, frequently appearing in literature, film, and fashion, symbolizing eternal aesthetic beauty.

self.zh: 艺术必须超越自然，但必须源于自然。
self.en: Art must transcend nature, but must originate from nature.

others.zh: 维米尔是一位用光作画的诗人，他的每一幅作品都是对日常生活的神圣化。
others.en: Vermeer is a poet who paints with light, each of his works is a sanctification of everyday life.

othersBy: 艺术评论家约翰·拉斯金
